scope: 扩大样本的单随机种子RGBD工程验证，不是正式算法比较或测试集结果
loss: original foreground BCE+Dice, Gaussian focal center, 5*foreground SmoothL1 offsets
augmentation: existing sample-seeded horizontal flip and RGB brightness [0.9,1.1]
schedule: linear warmup then cosine decay; plan fixed before validation
checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 1600 only; no early stopping or validation-based checkpoint choice
evaluation: one final model evaluation; frozen decoding; frame/scene/micro summaries, fresh and previously seen validation separate
exclusions: no grasp AP or robot success evaluated
no automatic step extension on failure
gate_interpretation: 预先设定的小规模继续投入门槛，非发表标准；单种子四个新验证场景仍不足以确认方法优势
